install_method: Docker image radixark/miles:v0.1.3 (upstream-recommended), imported with enroot into a squashfs, run with Pyxis; no venv
install_wall_s_notes: envs/miles/install.sh on a B200 node (job 364156): enroot import of the 23.3 GB image (114 layers) to a 46.0 GB .sqsh, with the source checkout already in place. The first git clone + checkout of the source on /fsx took about 4 more min. The same import on hopper-cpu (low QOS, spot) was preempted twice at ~18 min each, so it now runs inside the first GPU job. Import OK = `import torch, sglang, megatron.core, transformer_engine, fla, causal_conv1d` inside the container, about 1 min after container start.
install_steps_list: Write Megatron model args for Qwen3.5-2B (miles ships 0.8B/4B/9B/27B only): 0.8B args with hidden 2048 / ffn 6144 (launch/miles/common.sh:model_args)
Convert the HF checkpoint to Megatron torch_dist (tools/convert_hf_to_torch_dist.py under torchrun; 52 s for 2B on 2 B200s); scripted in convert_ckpt

Bypass miles' Python launchers, which pkill ray/sglang/miles/redis for the whole user on the node; start a private Ray head on job-derived ports and run train_async.py directly (launch/miles/common.sh)
Install math-verify for the shared reward (not in the image): uv --target overlay /fsx/amine_dirhoussi/envs/bench-miles
Convert W1 data to miles' input format (messages + label) and wrap the shared reward as a miles custom RM (configs/miles/prepare_w1_data.py, w1_reward.py)
Patch FA4 window handling so TE's flash attention is correct on Blackwell (configs/miles/fa4_window_fix/sitecustomize.py)
Complete each HF export with the frozen vision/MTP tensors from the base checkpoint so eval can load it (configs/miles/complete_hf_export.py)
venv_gb_notes: size of the imported squashfs image (/fsx/amine_dirhoussi/stable-bench-src/images/miles-v0.1.3.sqsh); the math-verify overlay is < 5 MB
first_step_s_notes: W1-S shared run 364471: job start 20:04:55Z -> first optimizer step logged 20:12:27Z. Breakdown: 49 s container start + version print + cached torch_dist check, then Ray/SGLang/Megatron init and the first 32-group rollout batch at up to 16384 tokens (step 0 step_time 259 s). Excludes queue time and the one-time HF->torch_dist conversion (52 s for 2B, cached).

patches.what: runtime wrapper around flash_attn.cute.interface._resolve_causal_local_window (FA4 4.0.0b35) mapping a negative window side to None
patches.why: TE 2.17.0+miles calls FA4 with window_size=(-1, 0) for causal attention; FA4 reads that as local attention with left window -1: wrong forward (max abs error 3.9 vs SDPA at head_dim 256) and the SM100 head_dim-256 backward asserts. Breaks miles' recommended --attention-backend flash on B200.
patches.how: configs/miles/fa4_window_fix/sitecustomize.py on PYTHONPATH (post-import hook); no files in the image are modified
